author: Cody'sLab
description:
I process the oxidized urine from my bio filter into (reasonably) pure potassium nitrate crystals. 
I think I’ve improved at this over the years, even though my equipment and supplies haven’t really changed. Hopefully, this one won’t get taken down. Supposedly, the issue with the older video was that I went all the way to gvnp0wder. Still, I share a lot of information here that the government might want to suppress, so get it while you can!
